websocket.description: Open it with the HTTP upgrade described by the OpenAPI operation connectWebSocket, which owns authentication, Origin, and the connection_id and sequence_number resume parameters. Every frame is one JSON text message. The server sends events, each with a sequence that increases by one; the client sends commands, each with a sequence it chooses, and the reply carries that sequence back. Clients ignore an event name they do not know.
websocket.summary: The one authenticated WebSocket of a Proctor installation.
websocket.title: WebSocket connection

role.changed.description: Refetch the Role: it was created, changed or archived. Delivered to connections that subscribe to role.view on the institution.
role.changed.name: role.changed
role.changed.summary: Refetch the Role; it or its permissions changed.
role.changed.title: Role changed

role_binding.changed.description: Refetch the Role Binding: it was granted or ended. Delivered to connections that subscribe to role_binding.view on the binding's own scope: the institution, an academic unit or a class. A binding at a Class also sends class.changed, since it changes the Class's teachers. The holder hears of it through current_user.context.changed.
role_binding.changed.name: role_binding.changed
role_binding.changed.summary: Refetch the Role Binding; it was granted or ended.
role_binding.changed.title: Role Binding changed

security_control_reply.name: security_control_reply
security_control_reply.summary: How the server processed the security control.
security_control_reply.title: Security control reply

subscribe.description: Each subscription is authorized on its own; the handshake grants none. Subscribing twice to the same pair succeeds once. A connection holds at most 256 subscriptions.
subscribe.name: subscribe
subscribe.summary: Starts receiving the events authorized by one action on one resource.
subscribe.title: Subscribe

subscription_reply.name: subscription_reply
subscription_reply.summary: The subscribe or unsubscribe command succeeded.
subscription_reply.title: Subscription reply

unsubscribe.description: Succeeds whether or not the subscription was held. The Sitting subscription an Attempt Connection holds is kept until the connection unbinds.
unsubscribe.name: unsubscribe
unsubscribe.summary: Stops receiving the events of one subscription.
unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe

user.changed.description: Refetch the User: their profile, account state, Affiliations, two-step state or memberships changed. The event names the User only. Delivered to connections that subscribe to user.view on the user; a subscription is admitted for a User the caller can see in the directory.
user.changed.name: user.changed
user.changed.summary: Refetch the User; their profile, account state, affiliations, two-step state or memberships changed.
user.changed.title: User changed

user_profile_picture_changed.description: The User's profile picture is now another File Entry. Delivered to the addressed User's connections.
user_profile_picture_changed.name: user_profile_picture_changed
user_profile_picture_changed.summary: The User's profile picture is now another File Entry.
user_profile_picture_changed.title: Profile picture changed

user_settings_changed.description: Refetch the User Settings document; the event carries only its new revision. Delivered to the addressed User's connections.
user_settings_changed.name: user_settings_changed
user_settings_changed.summary: Refetch the User Settings document; the event carries only its new revision.
user_settings_changed.title: User Settings changed

academic_period_changed.description: Names the Academic Period to refetch and, for a period an Academic Unit owns, that unit.
academic_period_changed.title: Academic Period changed

academic_unit_changed.description: Names the Academic Unit and, unless it is a root unit, its parent.
academic_unit_changed.title: Academic Unit changed

access_policy_changed.description: The Access Policy revision after a committed change. No policy fields are included.
access_policy_changed.title: Access Policy changed

attempt_evidence_changed.description: Names an Attempt that gained integrity Flags, evidence or native conditions, and the time the change is current as of. No evidence is included.
attempt_evidence_changed.title: Attempt evidence changed

class_changed.description: Names the Class to refetch and the Academic Unit that owns it through its Programme.
class_changed.title: Class changed

collection_invalidation.description: A content-free signal to refetch a collection. The envelope's user_id names the one User it is for.
collection_invalidation.title: Collection invalidation

command_error.description: A refused command. sequence is the request's, or 0 when the request had none.
command_error.title: Command error

command_reply.description: A successful reply to the command with the same sequence.

data.description: The command result, when the command returns one.

command_reply.title: Command reply

command_request.description: The envelope of every client-to-server command. The client chooses a positive sequence; the reply carries it back.

data.description: The command input. Each command defines its shape.

command_request.title: Command request

connect_security.description: Which admission the connect consumes: a fresh preflight for first admission and Ready rejoin, or the current Participation for a same-generation reconnect.

report_digest.description: The digest the report receipt returned; the report must be at most 30 seconds old.

connect_security.title: Connect security

event_frame.description: The envelope of every server-to-client event. sequence is assigned by the connection, increases by one per event, and is what a reconnecting client offers as sequence_number.

action.description: The action a subscription must hold to receive the event. Absent on an event addressed to one User.

data.description: The event payload. Each message defines its shape.

event_frame.title: Event frame

exam_archived.description: The Exam revision and instant of archiving.
exam_archived.title: Exam archived

exam_attempt_access_changed.description: The candidate's own Attempt was suspended or re-allowed. A suspension carries the safe reason of its source.
exam_attempt_access_changed.title: Attempt access changed

exam_attempt_assistant_approval_requeste.description: A command or edit waits for the candidate's approval. The summary is the command, or the path and new content, cut to 8 KiB. An unanswered request is declined at expires_at.
exam_attempt_assistant_approval_requeste.title: Assistant approval requested

exam_attempt_assistant_session_ended.description: A session ended for the candidate.
exam_attempt_assistant_session_ended.title: Assistant session ended

exam_attempt_assistant_session_started.description: A session started for the candidate.
exam_attempt_assistant_session_started.title: Assistant session started

exam_attempt_assistant_text_delta.description: One chunk of the assistant's reply, numbered from zero within the turn. Deltas are hints: a client that misses one reloads the transcript.
exam_attempt_assistant_text_delta.title: Assistant text delta

exam_attempt_assistant_tool_call.description: The assistant started or ended a tool call. Only the tool and the outcome are included; the arguments and result are in the transcript.
exam_attempt_assistant_tool_call.title: Assistant tool call

exam_attempt_assistant_turn_ended.description: The assistant's turn ended. Reload the transcript for the recorded reply.
exam_attempt_assistant_turn_ended.title: Assistant turn ended

exam_attempt_assistant_turn_started.description: The assistant started answering the candidate's message.
exam_attempt_assistant_turn_started.title: Assistant turn started

exam_attempt_assistant_unavailable.description: The model provider failed the turn. The exam goes on; the candidate may ask again after retry_after_seconds.
exam_attempt_assistant_unavailable.title: Assistant unavailable

exam_attempt_connect.description: Binds this WebSocket to the candidate's Attempt in the Sitting: admits a new Attempt, rejoins a Ready one, or resumes the current Participation.

continuity_credential.description: The Attempt Connection's continuity credential, chosen by Desktop at connect.

idempotency_key.description: Repeating the same connect with the same key replays its result.

initial_configuration.description: Exactly the OpenAPI component AttemptConfigurationCandidate. Sent on first admission; omitted when rejoining or resuming.

exam_attempt_connect.title: Exam Attempt connect

browser_policy.description: Exactly the OpenAPI component CandidateBrowserPolicy, or null when the Exam has no Browser policy.

renewal_interval_seconds.description: How often to send exam_attempt.renew, in seconds. The same value as AdmittedSecurity.renewal_interval_seconds.

replayed.description: The connect repeated an earlier one with the same idempotency key.

security.description: Exactly the OpenAPI component AdmittedSecurity. The immutable admitted binding receipt, including the effective native policy.

exam_attempt_connection_changed.description: An Attempt Connection opened or closed. close_reason is present only when it closed.
exam_attempt_connection_changed.title: Attempt Connection changed

exam_attempt_focus_loss.description: Reports one completed loss of focus of the candidate window. Sequences are per generation and increase by one; a skipped sequence is recorded as a gap.

continuity_credential.description: The Attempt Connection's continuity credential, chosen by Desktop at connect.

source.description: Optional classification of what lost focus.

exam_attempt_focus_loss.title: Exam Attempt Focus Loss

exam_attempt_focus_loss_reply.description: Acknowledges the signal. It tells the candidate's Desktop only what it must act on: never the threshold, outcome or Flag.

policy_disabled.description: The Exam does not collect Focus Loss; the signal was only acknowledged.

suspension_created.description: The Attempt was suspended and this Connection closed.

warning_created.description: Show the candidate the Focus Loss warning.

exam_attempt_focus_loss_reply.title: Exam Attempt Focus Loss reply

exam_attempt_focus_warning.description: Warns the candidate that their Focus Loss crossed the policy threshold. No counts, thresholds or evidence are included.
exam_attempt_focus_warning.title: Focus Loss warning

exam_attempt_integrity_flagged.description: An Integrity Flag a policy raised or added evidence to (Focus Loss, or native.<capability> when an enforce rule's occurrence opens), its policy outcome and how many evidence episodes were kept or overflowed. The evidence itself is never included.
exam_attempt_integrity_flagged.title: Attempt Integrity Flag raised

exam_attempt_reallowed.description: The closed Attempt Suspension and the Attempt revision after the change. The manager's reason is never included.
exam_attempt_reallowed.title: Attempt re-allowed

exam_attempt_renew.description: Renews the Participation lease and carries the security control. The whole data object is at most 16 KiB.

sequence.description: The renewal's own sequence within the generation.

exam_attempt_renew.title: Exam Attempt renewal

duplicate.description: The renewal sequence was already accepted; the lease was not extended again.

exam_attempt_screen_clips_requested.description: Tells the candidate's Desktop that its Attempt has screen clip requests it has not taken, so it reads them now instead of at its next poll. Neither the requests nor who made them are included.
exam_attempt_screen_clips_requested.title: Screen clips requested

exam_attempt_security_update.description: Carries a security control between renewals. It never extends the lease. The whole data object is at most 16 KiB.
exam_attempt_security_update.title: Exam Attempt security update

exam_attempt_submitted.description: A submitted Attempt for Sitting viewers, with who or what submitted it.
exam_attempt_submitted.title: Attempt submitted

exam_attempt_submitted_for_candidate.description: The candidate's own copy of the submission. It leaves out the candidate identity.
exam_attempt_submitted_for_candidate.title: Attempt submitted, candidate copy

exam_attempt_suspended.description: An Attempt Suspension for Sitting viewers. A policy suspension names its Connection and Integrity Flag; a kick names no Flag and no Connection when none was open.
exam_attempt_suspended.title: Attempt suspended

exam_attempt_workspace_changed.description: A refetch hint for the candidate's Attempt Workspace after one committed batch. The batch took the cursors from first_workspace_cursor to workspace_cursor. Paths, content and mutation bodies are never included.
exam_attempt_workspace_changed.title: Attempt Workspace changed

exam_counts_changed.description: Names the Exam whose catalogue counts should be refetched. No count, candidate or Submission is named.
exam_counts_changed.title: Exam counts changed

exam_created.description: Names the new Exam and the Academic Unit that owns it.
exam_created.title: Exam created

exam_draft_updated.description: The Draft revision after a text or policy change. Authored content is never included.
exam_draft_updated.title: Exam Draft updated

exam_integrity_discrepancy_recorded.description: A Focus Loss claim arrived after the Attempt or Sitting ended. Its duration and source are never included.
exam_integrity_discrepancy_recorded.title: Integrity Discrepancy recorded

exam_integrity_review.description: The Integrity Review's identity, state and release state. Decisions, rationale, evidence and notes are never included.
exam_integrity_review.title: Integrity Review state

exam_manager_changed.description: A User added as an Exam Manager (present true) or removed (present false).
exam_manager_changed.title: Exam Manager changed

exam_owner_transferred.description: The new owner and the Exam revision the transfer produced.
exam_owner_transferred.title: Exam owner transferred

exam_revision_published.description: The published Revision's number, kind and policy digest. Published content is never included.
exam_revision_published.title: Exam Revision published

exam_sitting_changed.description: A Sitting's state and revision after it was scheduled, rescheduled or canceled. Times, Class and Exam Revision are never included.
exam_sitting_changed.title: Exam Sitting changed

exam_sitting_content_corrected.description: A live correction moved the Sitting to another Exam Revision. Refetch the presentation.
exam_sitting_content_corrected.title: Exam Sitting content corrected

exam_sitting_lifecycle_changed.description: One committed lifecycle transition or deadline extension.
exam_sitting_lifecycle_changed.title: Exam Sitting lifecycle changed

exam_starter_workspace_changed.description: One committed Starter Workspace mutation. Paths, object identities and bytes are never included.
exam_starter_workspace_changed.title: Starter Workspace changed

exam_student_result_released_for_candida.description: Tells the candidate their Student Result was released. It carries the Review's identity and state, never its content.
exam_student_result_released_for_candida.title: Student Result released, candidate copy

hello.description: The first event on every connection. Keep connection_id and the last processed sequence to resume.

node_id.description: The node that owns the connection.

resumed.description: True when the connection resumed and replayed the missed events.

hello.title: Hello

instant.description: An RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with up to microsecond precision.
instant.title: Instant

invitation_changed.description: Names an Invitation visible in the addressed scope, the state it reached and the scope it grants at. The accepting User is never included.
invitation_changed.title: Invitation changed

job_changed.description: Names a Job whose status changed or whose progress advanced, so an operator view refetches it. The command, checkpoint, result and errors are never included.

type.description: The Job type, as GET /api/v1/jobs reports it.

job_changed.title: Job changed

job_progress.description: The progress a running Job last checkpointed. Present only for a Job type that reports progress.
job_progress.title: Job progress

mail_delivery_changed.description: Names the mail delivery whose state changed. The recipient and the message are never included.
mail_delivery_changed.title: Mail delivery changed

onboarding_import_changed.description: Names an onboarding import that entered a new state. Rows, counts and the file name are never included.
onboarding_import_changed.title: Onboarding import changed

plugin_settings_changed.description: The plugin whose settings an administrator changed, and their revision after the committed change. No setting values are included.
plugin_settings_changed.title: Plugin settings changed

protocol_error.description: A stable error code and a localized message. Exam Attempt commands may add recovery members; clients ignore members they do not know.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a rate-limited command.

protocol_error.title: Protocol error

resource.description: The resource an event is authorized against. Both members are empty strings on an event addressed to one User.
resource.title: Authorization resource

retention_changed.description: Says which retention read to refetch: the policy, a hold (with the hold and its Exam), or an Exam's records due for removal.
retention_changed.title: Retention changed

role_binding_changed.description: Names the Role Binding to refetch, its holder, its Role and the scope it is bound at.
role_binding_changed.title: Role Binding changed

screen_clip_changed.description: Names a screen clip that was requested or changed state. Its reason, range and state stay in the clip list.
screen_clip_changed.title: Screen clip changed

security_control.description: Desktop's security control: its sequence, the binding it renews and the delivery watermarks it has allocated. At most 16 KiB. The server identifies a control by the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (object keys sorted, integers only, JSON.stringify string escaping), so key order and whitespace do not matter; duplicate keys, unknown members and non-integer numbers are refused. A retained sequence sent again with different content is refused with exam.security.control_conflict; an older sequence changes nothing. The server refuses a control whose policy is no longer current with exam.security.policy_changed.

delivery_watermarks.description: The admitted native stream and the Browser sources owned by the current Participation, each at most once. At most 50.

source_id.description: For the native family, the admitted delivery_stream_id; for a Browser source, that source's ID.

stream_id.description: The admitted native delivery stream: exactly AdmittedSecurity.delivery_stream_id from the connect reply. A control naming another stream is refused.

security_control.title: Security control

security_control_result.description: How the server processed Desktop's latest security control. A control never changes whether the candidate may interact; only closing native delivery does.
security_control_result.title: Security control result

sitting_board_invalidation.description: Names the Exam Sitting whose manager board should be refetched. Candidate and Attempt identities are never included.
sitting_board_invalidation.title: Sitting board invalidation

sitting_submissions_changed.description: Names the Exam Sitting whose submission list should be refetched. No Submission, candidate or review is named.
sitting_submissions_changed.title: Sitting submissions changed

subscription.description: An action and the exact resource it is checked against.
subscription.title: Subscription

user_changed.description: Names the User to refetch. What changed is never included.
user_changed.title: User changed

user_profile_picture_changed.description: The File Entry that is now the User's profile picture and the User revision after the change.
user_profile_picture_changed.title: User profile picture changed

user_settings_changed.description: The new revision of the User's settings document, never the document itself.
user_settings_changed.title: User Settings changed

info.description: The messages of the authenticated WebSocket at /api/v1/websocket. The HTTP upgrade itself is the OpenAPI operation connectWebSocket. Realtime events tell an interface that something changed; durable HTTP resources remain the authority.
info.title: Proctor Realtime API

receiveExamAttemptConnect.summary: The server admits, rejoins or resumes the Attempt and binds this connection.
receiveExamAttemptConnect.title: Connect to the Exam Attempt

receiveExamAttemptFocusLoss.summary: The server applies the Exam's Focus Loss policy to the signal.
receiveExamAttemptFocusLoss.title: Report a Focus Loss

receiveExamAttemptRenew.summary: The server extends the lease and processes the security control.
receiveExamAttemptRenew.title: Renew the Exam Attempt Participation

receiveExamAttemptSecurityUpdate.summary: The server processes a security control without extending the lease.
receiveExamAttemptSecurityUpdate.title: Update the security control

receivePing.summary: The server answers ping with pong.
receivePing.title: Ping

receiveSubscribe.summary: The server authorizes and records one subscription.
receiveSubscribe.title: Subscribe

sendEvent.description: An event reaches a connection when its user_id, if present, is the connection's User and its action and resource, if present, match one of the connection's subscriptions. Events are best-effort signals sent after the change commits; refetch over HTTP for authoritative state.
sendEvent.summary: The server sends hello, then the events the connection may receive.
sendEvent.title: Send events

proctor.description: One Proctor installation. Replace the host with the installation's public origin.
